objective: Remove Connect chat's small backward rebound when readers scroll to the latest messages, without breaking sender auto-follow or paginated older history.
productionBaselineEvidence: Inspected GitHub main source at ac48fcee3236470162d5284ece7bca9aed84faf3 on 2026-11-17. Live RC, production OTA update group, and device behavior not independently verified. This branch is DEV-only and does not authorize staging or production publication.
chosenApproach: Stop FlatList's always-on maintainVisibleContentPosition from competing with explicit latest scroll. Restore scroll offset precisely once when older messages are prepended. Suppress content-resize auto-stick during finger drag and momentum, and disable edge rubber-banding.
alternativeApproaches: Keep always-on native position correction and add more forced scrollToEnd calls (rejected: opposing scroll controllers create rebound)
Invert the entire FlatList (rejected: broad changes to pagination, grouping, chronological read receipts and composer)
selectionRationale: A single scroll owner for each intent preserves native reading gestures, explicitly follows the newest message only when appropriate, and locally compensates for older history without changing message order or database interactions. Protected ads/finance/points classification is a filename false positive (Thread contains ad); no monetization path changes.
preserveBehaviors: Both personal and scoped Connect conversations share the same thread renderer
Initial latest-message anchoring and own-send scroll-to-end
Paging older messages without replacing or duplicating conversation history
Read/unread state, focus-message routing, pending sends, reactions and attachments
Existing authentication, RLS, offline message cache, calls and persistent nav
acceptanceChecks: Scrolling to the latest messages ends without a backward rebound caused by dual position preservation
Manual drag/momentum is never interrupted by content-size auto-follow
Idle near-bottom follows new messages and own send still snaps to the new message
Older history prepends compensate visible offset without forcing latest
No runtime, Supabase, AdMob, navigation or OTA changes; Android visual smoke check required before RC
